mode: INTERNATIONAL-FIRST • EVIDENCE BEFORE EXPLANATION • OFFICIAL DAILY PUBLISHING QUEUE V1

rules.primary_goal: 1 MAINLINE REEL + at least 1 LINKED STILL every day
rules.source_generation_format: 9:16 • Audio ON • Seedance 2.0 Fast when applicable
rules.final_edit_duration_note: Generation source is capped at 10 seconds. Final edited Reel may be longer after post-production when continuity and pacing require it.
rules.wow_rule: Every mainline day needs a distinct instant visual abnormality; no filler forest imagery.
rules.series_rule: Change at least 3 of 4 each day: location, viewpoint, threat mechanism, reveal type.
rules.footprint_cooldown: Footprint may be the main hook no more than once per 7 days.
rules.giant_silhouette_cooldown: Giant silhouette may be the main hook no more than once per 5 days.
rules.linked_still_rule: Still must support or extend the Reel, not duplicate the exact Reel frame.
rules.forest_rule: The forest is the main character. Creature/scale is a controlled HERO mechanism, not the default.
rules.catch_up_rule: If the previous Still is already published but its Reel is pending, close that episode with the Reel before opening the next episode.

series_phases.goal: Surveillance, physics and environmental reactions without repeating the opening footprints.
Archive, rules, sound and physical scale build the history of the forest.
Camera, radio, scale, notes and thermal evidence prove the anomaly is interacting with the team.
System-wide anomalies, new locations and an escalating finale without falling back to another shadow portrait.
